project_context.vibe: Immersive scroll-world, scrollytelling, parallax/animations, 3D-feeling scroll experience

headings.font: Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or Clash Display
headings.strategy: Expressive, large typography (text-5xl to text-7xl for hero), tight tracking. Use uppercase tracking-[0.2em] for small labels.

accents.strategy: Used for overlines, labels, small structural elements.

colors.strategy: Avoid generic SaaS blue. Utilize Void Black as primary canvas. Frost/Glass effects over #0B0B0F. Ensure high contrast against the dark background. DO NOT USE pure transparent backgrounds where content overlap happens.

visual_enhancers.grid_backgrounds: Use subtle repeating radial gradients or CSS grid lines (border-upBorder/20) for technical aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-5%) to remove digital flatness.

layouts.hero: Cinematic full-screen (min-h-screen) with floating elements, large typography. Headline: 'Transforme métricas em estratégia'. Background could include subtle abstract 3D elements or glowing orbs.
layouts.bento_grid: For UP Analytics & UP Creator showcases. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Mix spanning items.
layouts.section_spacing: Generous padding (py-24 to py-32) to let the dark theme breathe.
layouts.scrollytelling: Sticky sections where content on left stays while right side scrolls through features (or vice versa). Use Framer Motion useScroll hook.

motion.scroll_world: Use Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform for parallax, text reveals, and opacity fades as users scroll.
motion.micro_interactions: Magnetic buttons, hover lifts (-translate-y-1), ghost-to-solid button transitions.
motion.reveal: Staggered fade-up for list items, scale-in for images.
motion.chart_animations: For UP Analytics: animate height/width of bars on enter. For UP Creator: hover on video cards scales up and shows 'Play' icon.

components.header: Sticky nav, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-upBlack/70, border-b border-upBorder. Logo on left, navigation center, CTA right.
components.hero_section: Deep dark void background with a glowing coral aura. Animated text reveal. Dual CTAs.
components.analytics_showcase: Animated dashboard mockups, charts drawing themselves, numbers counting up. Abstract network background.
components.creator_showcase: Netflix-style horizontal scroll/carousel for course shelf. Video cards with hover preview, learning tracks, progress bars.
components.how_it_works: Cycle section (Aprenda -> Aplique -> Meça -> Cresça) with scroll-linked progress indicator.
components.pricing: 3 plans: UP Start (R$97), UP Pro (R$197 - highlighted with glowing border and larger scale), UP Agência (R$497). 7-day trial mentions.
components.cta_section: Final high-impact CTA linking to /register, with a minimalist footer.
components.scroll_indicator: Fixed progress bar at the top or side.

abstract_network.description: Abstract 3D network/cubes, perfect for UP Analytics / AI background texture.

video_course_tablet.description: Person working at desk watching tablet - Use for UP Creator showcase.

dark_texture.description: Dark geometric texture (tunnel/curves) for section transitions or deep backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA against #0B0B0F and #111116. Ensure upPink (#FF5368) has sufficient contrast on dark mode, use text-shadow if overlaid on images.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for buttons, especially icon-only buttons. Use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='pricing-pro-cta')
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query for heavy parallax.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end, Next.js 14 marketing landing page.
Update 'src/app/page.tsx' completely to implement this design.
Use Framer Motion extensively for scroll animations, text reveals, and parallax. (Add 'use client' where necessary).
In the Pricing section, emphasize the 'UP Pro' plan with a subtle glow (drop-shadow using upPink) and a slightly larger scale.

IMPORTANT: the app uses Tailwind config colors 'upPink', 'upPinkDark', 'upBlack', 'upDark', 'upCard', 'upBorder', 'upGray'. DO NOT use arbitrary colors like 'bg-[#111116]', use 'bg-upCard' or 'bg-upBlack'.
For the 'UP Analytics' section, build an animated Dashboard mock UI with Tailwind (divs resembling charts) - no need for complex charting libraries unless necessary, but motion is key.
For the 'UP Creator' section, implement a horizontal scrollable row (Netflix-style shelf) of course cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds where content overlap happens.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing (py-24 to py-32) than feels comfortable.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠.
